page_title: FRE 2-0 KOL | Freiburg v FC Koln 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' 2 - 0 Goal – 2:0! Michael Gregoritsch sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Roland Sallai (Freiburg) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom right corner.
90+4' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Merlin Rohl leaves the pitch and Junior Adamu (Freiburg) comes on.
90+3' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+2' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

89' He should have scored! Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Freiburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
89' Surely that's handball by one of the Freiburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
83' The resulting corner from Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) comes to nothing.
83' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Freiburg will take a corner kick.
82' Freiburg are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
76' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' It's time for a substitution. Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) comes on in place of Kiliann Sildillia.
75' Substitution. Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jordy Makengo walks off.
73' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Max Finkgrafe and he is replaced by Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln).
72' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
70' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
66' Jan Thielmann goes off the pitch and Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln) comes on.
66' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
66' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo is replaced by Roland Sallai (Freiburg).
65' Substitution. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) replaces Lucas Holer.
62' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) is being dismissed by the referee, after receiving two yellow cards, followed by a red.
61' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Florian Kainz will be replaced by Mark Uth (1. FC Koln).
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) for Luca Waldschmidt.
61' The substitution is prepared. Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dejan Ljubicic.
57' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) for a tough tackle.
56' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
51' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
50' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Freiburg as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

49' Play continues despite the shouts by some Freiburg players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Harm Osmers interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
48' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
47' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
46' Harm Osmers blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' An attempted cross from Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
45+3' The corner by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
45+2' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
40' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
36' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
33' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
31' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
30' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Now Freiburg have a corner.
30' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Harm Osmers's book.
30' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

29' A sweet pass finds Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Marvin Schwabe is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
27' A yellow card for a tackle by Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln). Harm Osmers doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
26' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
24' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) tries to find Lucas Holer, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
21' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
20' FC Koln are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

11' What a chance that is! Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.

10' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Noah Atubolu, who pulls off a decent save!
8' The referee blows his whistle as Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) was too aggressive in his challenge. Freiburg are awarded the free kick.
7' Timo Hubers (1. FC Koln) brings an opponent down and Harm Osmers interrupts the game. A free kick is awarded to Freiburg.
6' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes it short.

4' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.
3' Freiburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. FC Koln will have the kick-off.
Harm Osmers will officiate today.
